manufacturerStatements: The standard Team TLS page says a wider-fitting version is also available.
Nitro describes the Wide version as providing additional room for snowboarders who need it while retaining the Team's versatile flex and all-mountain performance.

Nitro's official German 2026/27 Team TLS Wide page says: 'Die Wide Version bietet eine um 4mm breitere Passform' (the Wide version offers a fit that is 4 mm wider). The page does not define a measurement location or method.

The Wide product page lists men's US 7-15, Mondopoint 25.0-33.0, EU 38 2/3-49 1/3 and UK 6-14. The regular page lists the same model size range. These are published size ranges, not proof of current inventory in each size.
